blocks.text: Bank aur financial services blockchain istemal kar ke transactions ko tez aur mehfooz banate hain. Maslan abroad (doosre mulk) paisa bhejna sust aur mehnga ho sakta hai; blockchain ise tez aur sasta bana deta hai.

blocks.alt: Digital identity (pehchan) ka flow: User apni ID APP se Identity Issuer(s) se attestations (pehchan ki pakki gawahi) mangta aur leta hai, unhein Identity Verifier(s) ko jaanch ke liye dikhata hai, aur Identity Hub mein encrypted attestations mehfooz karta hai. App pehchan blockchain par register karti hai aur verifier wahan se pehchan dekhta (lookup) hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 6.4: Bank mein tez aur mehfooz transactions ke liye blockchain (kitab ki Figure 6.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Flow yun hai: ek organization (Identity Issuer, maslan board ya bank) user ki pehchan ki attestation (pakki gawahi) deta hai; user use apni ID app mein rakhta hai aur encrypted copy Identity Hub mein mehfooz karta hai; jab kisi doosre organization (Identity Verifier) ko dikhata hai to woh blockchain par pehchan dekh (lookup) kar foran verify kar leta hai, kaghazi kaam ke baghair. Kitab ka caption 'banking mein tez aur mehfooz transactions' kehta hai, lekin tasveer asal mein digital pehchan ki verification (jaanch kar pakka karna) dikhati hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 6.4 mein label 'Identity Verifirt (s)' chhapa hai; sahi lafz 'Identity Verifier(s)' hai, yani pehchan ki jaanch karne wale organizations. Upar ki drawing mein sahi label hai.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: Is activity mein students dekhenge ke Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education (BISE) ke jaari kiye certificates ki verification ke liye blockchain kaise istemal ho sakta hai, aur is ka traditional manual verification se comparison (saath rakh kar farq dekhna) karenge. Sochiye certificates aam taur par kaise verify hote hain: aap jaari karne wale organization ko request dete hain, woh haath se certificate jaanch kar us ke asli hone ko verify karta hai. Yeh kaam waqt leta hai, is mein ghalti ho sakti hai aur dhoke ka khatra hota hai. Ab sochiye blockchain is ko kaise badal sakta hai: organization certificate ki details decentralized ledger par record karta hai. Yeh record na badalne wala (immutable) aur transparent (saaf, sab ke saamne) hai, is liye koi bhi blockchain dekh kar jaldi aur mehfooz tareeqe se certificate ko verify kar sakta hai. Groups mein kaam karein, blockchain simulation tool se certificates ki example details record karein, phir blockchain record dekh kar unhein verify kar ke dikhayein. Blockchain wale aur manual tareeqe ka farq discuss karein: efficiency (raftar), security, accuracy (sahi hona) aur scalability. Aakhir mein aap samajh jayenge ke blockchain certificate ki verification ko tez, mehfooz aur dhoke se pak kaise banata hai.

blocks.prompt: Class Activity ka namuna: BISE certificate ki manual aur blockchain verification ka comparison.
blocks.explanation: Manual: board ko request, staff ke records jaanchne ka intezar; der lagti hai, ghalti aur jaali certificate ka khatra. Blockchain: board har certificate ki details ek dafa na badalne wale ledger par likh deta hai; koi bhi foran jaanch sakta hai; jaali certificate banana mushkil; hazaron requests bhi aasani se (scalable).
